name: Agent Tab Grouper
description: Renders a per-session tab group for CDP-driven automation tabs, serves the Agent Monitor (a live CCTV grid), and carries Tier 1 realness — a Chrome-real fingerprint (UA-CH + sec-ch-ua), with the version derived from this browser rather than stored. Never a source of truth: which tabs belong to a session is answered from that session's registry over plain CDP, so the harness works on browsers with no extension at all.
